summary: Correction counts use distinct dispatched attempts since the last productive acceptance, regardless of failure kind. The work-wide nonprogress budget also counts completed no_ship attempts and survives step, disposition, correction-request, and contract changes. Only productive acceptance resets the window. On repair-capable pins, the one CD-0205 D4 funded confirming review is the sole dispatch admitted at the wall without a store-derived basis; the repairing acceptance resets nothing, and only its accepted ship review is productive for the repaired obligations. Failure and rejection use the dispatch-count comparator; verification uses correction requests since the last healthy verdict.
title: Correction attempts count every dispatch
